sources.title: Law of Turkmenistan on Migration
sources.officialityEvidence: The original Migration Law is published on the official state portal; the separately cited 2025 amendment records the current electronic-visa changes.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreign citizens ... may enter and stay ... on the basis of an entry visa.

sources.title: 2025 amendments to the Law on Migration: electronic visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The amendment is published on the official state turkmenistan.gov.tm portal and records that it entered into force on publication.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Electronic visas are processed in the information system of the State Migration Service.

sources.title: Registration of foreign nationals at addresses
sources.officialityEvidence: The live migration.gov.tm State Migration Service page is dated 7 August 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreign citizens ... may come and stay ... on the basis of a visa.

sources.title: Tariffs of consular fees of Turkmenistan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official MFA page publishes Turkmenistan’s visa-fee and airport-issuance tariffs.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For the issuance of visas at the international airport of Ashgabat, an additional charge is 50 US dollars.

sources.title: Border-crossing rules for Turkmenistan citizens
sources.officialityEvidence: The official State Migration Service page identifies a Turkmen citizen’s biometric passport as a document authorising entry to Turkmenistan.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passport ... for leaving Turkmenistan and entering Turkmenistan.

sources.title: Law of Turkmenistan on Migration: citizen entry right
sources.officialityEvidence: The official state portal publishes the Migration Law provision on a Turkmen citizen’s entry right.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Every citizen of Turkmenistan has a right ... [of] entry to Turkmenistan.

policies.title: Turkmenistan: citizen right of entry
policies.summary: Turkmenistan’s Migration Law and current Migration Service guidance directly establish a Turkmen citizen’s right to enter with the prescribed citizen travel document.
conditions: The current Migration Service identifies the biometric Turkmen passport as an entry document; the Migration Law establishes the citizen entry right. This is not a foreign visitor visa exemption.
This does not decide dual-nationality/document choice, exit restrictions, residence, work, military, registration, security or individual border treatment.

unresolved.reason: The current Migration Law states a foreign citizen enters and stays on an entry visa unless an international treaty provides otherwise. Current official material does not publish an exhaustive, current ordinary-passport treaty-exemption list, a nationality schedule for any eVisa category, or nationality conditions for airport issuance; the legal default therefore cannot be turned into a code-specific complement.
